events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts

The Flood Watch will expire for portions of northern and northwest
Virginia, including the following areas, in northern Virginia,
Culpeper, Northern Fauquier and Southern Fauquier. In northwest
Virginia, Madison and Rappahannock.

at 2 AM EDT early this morning.
